evidence.source_assertion: The native right side explicitly contains CPD-9992 with coefficient 1; direction is PHYSIOL-LEFT-TO-RIGHT.

The issued CPD-9992 InChI has the monoanion layer /p-1 and the stereochemical layers /t9-,10+,13-/m1/s1. The structure alone does not establish physiological product ratios or enzyme release selectivity.

ChEBI names this neutral structure pyochelin I. Its connectivity and stereochemical InChI layers match native CPD-9992 after removing /p-1; this independently derived I assignment is protonation-normalized, not exact charge equivalence.
